StudioWorkspace.title: StudioWorkspace
StudioWorkspace.description: Shared Plot Witch Brand Builder workspace metadata, active campaign brief, canonical spec, and copy draft.

activePresetId.description: ID of the currently active brand preset.

activeTemplateId.description: ID of the currently active product listing or template.

isAnchorApproved.description: Whether the current master product anchor image is approved.

canonicalSpecJson.description: Serialized CanonicalProductSpec for the active campaign.

copyDraftJson.description: Serialized AssetCopyDraft for the active workspace.

presetsJson.description: Serialized list of saved BrandPreset objects.

listingsJson.description: Serialized list of saved product listings (metadata and specs).

scheduledPostsJson.description: Serialized list of Content Calendar scheduled posts.

mediumMetaJson.description: Serialized metadata for generated medium sizes.

ImageChunk.title: ImageChunk
ImageChunk.description: Chunked image storage document for master anchor images and generated campaign sizes (stays well under the 1MB Firestore document limit).

imageKey.description: Logical key for the image (e.g., anchor_main, medium_etsy_listing, listing_plot-witch-default).

totalChunks.description: Total number of chunks for this imageKey.

dataChunk.description: Slice of data URL or path string (max 650,000 chars).

/studios/{studioId}.description: Main server-managed shared workspace document storing presets, campaigns, listings metadata, and content calendar entries.

/studios/{studioId}/imageChunks/{chunkId.description: Chunked image documents for master anchor images and generated medium sizes.
